payload.title: A FIFO named .gitignore anywhere in the seat's tree stalls lift_sandbox_pin's listing for hermetic_git's 60 s timeout and then raises a raw subprocess.TimeoutExpired, not a named GovernanceError, although _read_beneath's docstring says a fifo cannot stall the kernel
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:689-690 (ls-files --others --exclude-standard: git opens an in-tree ignore file with a blocking open())
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:703 (the docstring claim 'a fifo cannot stall the kernel')
payload.rule_violated: A seat's untrusted output is refused by a named error, never by a crash or a stall: every refusal of the lift is a GovernanceError that names its reason
payload.notes: Registered by the D6-SEC findings clerk from the D6-SEC review round 1 (lens security), re-checked at head d460f7917 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: The listing cannot block on an entry the seat made: either the lift catches the timeout and raises a GovernanceError named red_first_sandbox_unreadable, or the listing is built by a kernel-side walk that applies ignore rules only from regular files. Test: a FIFO named .gitignore in the tree makes lift_sandbox_pin raise a GovernanceError whose reason starts with red_first_sandbox_unreadable, not subprocess.TimeoutExpired.
